title: India’s Foreign Minister Jaishankar Openly Calls Out the US
author: Sudha Ramachandran
text:
India’s Minister of External Affairs Dr S. Jaishankar in a discussion with Daniel Russel, vice president for International Security and Diplomacy at Asia Society Policy Institute, New York, Sept. 29, 2026.
Credit: X/Dr. S. Jaishankar
On September 28, India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi had a telephone conversation with U.S. President Donald Trump to review progress in bilateral cooperation. In a post on X, Modi described the conversation as “productive.” “We reviewed our bilateral cooperation in trade, defence, energy, critical technologies and other areas. We agreed to maintain close engagement to take our Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership forward,” he said.While Modi’s post about his conversation with Trump was not negative, it was far less effusive than in the past, even bland. As Yashraj Sharma observed in an article in Al Jazeera, it was a “cold and formal depiction far removed from his description of the US president as a ‘good friend’ in previous years.”[...]
